NOTICE HOW BATMAN WAS NOT BUILT
ON {\c&H0000D7FF&}FEARLESSNESS{\c&HFFFFFF&},

BUT ON THE VERY {\c&H000030D0&}TERROR{\c&HFFFFFF&}
THAT BROKE BRUCE WAYNE.

AS A BOY, BRUCE PLUNGED
INTO A {\c&H0000D7FF&}COLLAPSED WELL{\c&HFFFFFF&}

WHERE A SHRIEKING SWARM OF {\c&H0000D7FF&}BATS{\c&HFFFFFF&}
{\c&H000030D0&}SCARRED HIS MIND{\c&HFFFFFF&}.

HIS FATHER TAUGHT HIM THAT {\c&H0000D7FF&}FALLING{\c&HFFFFFF&}
IS HOW WE LEARN TO RISE,

BUT THE TRAUMA REMAINED
TRAPPED IN THE {\c&H0000D7FF&}DARKNESS{\c&HFFFFFF&}.

YEARS LATER, HENRI DUCARD
FORCES HIM TO {\c&H0000D7FF&}FACE THE TRUTH{\c&HFFFFFF&}:

TO MASTER YOUR ENEMY,
YOU HAVE TO {\c&H0000D7FF&}BECOME IT{\c&HFFFFFF&}.

DEEP INSIDE THE CAVE, BRUCE STEPS
DIRECTLY INTO THE {\c&H0000D7FF&}BAT SWARM{\c&HFFFFFF&}.

HE STOPS RUNNING.
HE {\c&H0000D7FF&}RISES WITH THEM{\c&HFFFFFF&}.

WHEN ALFRED ASKS WHY BATS,
BRUCE GIVES THE {\c&H0000D7FF&}DEFINITIVE ANSWER{\c&HFFFFFF&}:

HE INVERTED IT INTO HIS {\c&H0000D7FF&}ARMOR{\c&HFFFFFF&},
HIS {\c&H0000D7FF&}WEAPON{\c&HFFFFFF&}, AND HIS {\c&H0000D7FF&}PERMANENT IDENTITY{\c&HFFFFFF&}.
